Dear Colleagues, please check if swapping the converter fixes the problem, otherwise please replace it. For the Mainfan error, please check if the 230V are reaching the mainfan and if yes, the please make sure that the XD7.1 is attached properly.
Worst case scenario, please replace the Fan.
